memories.content: The user changed their schedule once in November 2024 because of their mother's hospital visit.
After seeing the reason for the schedule change written in a calendar invitation, the user asked for it to be removed.
The user was able to reschedule the appointment after providing only a new time, without a reason.
On a day the user traveled in their father's car, they photographed the parking location.
On the next visit, when the user did not take a photo, they walked one circuit of the parking garage while looking for the exit.
After hearing preparation items from their mother by phone, the user omitted two items.
After receiving the preparation items again by text, the user put all of them in their bag.
The user's mother does not want the reason for her visit disclosed in the user's external schedule.
Do not include the mother's reason for a visit when conveying the user's availability externally.
Some daily-life services may operate for shorter hours during the year-end holiday period.
The user keeps a portable fan charger on a living-room shelf.
On a hot day, the user worked with only the window open and lost focus in the afternoon.
In the room where the user closed the curtains the next morning, the temperature rose less.
The user took the portable fan out without charging it, and it turned off after an hour.
Before the next outing, the user charged it the night before and used the fan throughout the trip.
On a hot weekend, the user was eating lunch in their father's yard and moved indoors.
When the user returned to the yard in the evening, shade and wind led them to stay another hour.
The user's father prefers to move an outdoor meal to the evening rather than proceed at midday when the temperature is high.
The local agent can compare past responses to heat but cannot know the current felt temperature without an indoor temperature record.
A room with a west-facing window can warm rapidly in the late afternoon.

analysis.overview: The frames cover separate practical domains. The reference frame centers on schedule privacy, preparation, parking navigation, and holiday availability, while the compared frame records heat-management experiences, fan readiness, outdoor-meal timing, and temperature-assessment limits. Neither frame supplies a scope-aligned counterpart to the other.
